title: Applying for a residents' parking permit
context: You will hear a woman phoning her local council to apply for a parking permit.

lines.t: Westfield Council parking services, Neil speaking. How can I help?
Hi, I've just moved into the area and bought a car, and I need a residents' parking permit. I got a warning ticket yesterday, so I'd like to sort it out today if I can.
No problem, I can do the application over the phone. Can I start with your surname?
It's Szymanski. S-Z-Y-M-A-N-S-K-I.
Let me read that back. S-Z-I-M...
No, it's Y after the Z, not I. So S-Z-Y-M-A-N-S-K-I. And it ends in I.
Got it, sorry. First name?
Kate.
And the address the permit is for?
Flat 14, 22 Wellington Terrace. Oh, hang on, no. Flat 14 was my old flat on the other side of the road. I'm in Flat 40 now. Four zero.
Flat 40, 22 Wellington Terrace. Postcode?
S-E-1-5, 4-R-J. Actually, no, sorry. It's 4-R-G. R-J is the building next door, the mail gets mixed up all the time.
SE15 4RG. And a daytime phone number?
Well, there's a landline in the flat, but I'm never home during the day, so you'd better have my mobile. It's 0 7 9 4 6, 2 1 8, 0 3 5.
Now the vehicle. What make is it?
It's a Mazda. I had a Honda back in Australia, so I keep wanting to say Honda. But it's definitely a Mazda.
And the colour?
Black. Well, it looks black at night, but in daylight it's really dark blue, and that's what it says on the registration document, so you'd better put dark blue.
And the registration number?
L-K-1-9, T-N-V. No, wait, I'm reading it off my insurance letter and the print is tiny. It's T-N-W, W for whisky. So L-K-1-9, T-N-W.
Thanks. Now, there are three types of permit. There's a quarterly permit, a six-month permit and an annual permit.
I suppose the annual one works out cheapest?
It does, per month. But you did say you'd only just moved in. Is it a long-term rental?

Not really. My contract ends in the summer and I might move to another part of London. So the annual one doesn't make sense. And quarterly sounds like a lot of paperwork. I'll take the six-month permit.
Right. The six-month permit is normally sixty-five pounds. But let me just check the car. Is it a hybrid by any chance?
Yes, it is.
Then there's a twenty per cent discount for low-emission vehicles, so it comes down to fifty-two pounds.
Oh, that's good news. Can I pay by card now?
You can, but first I need proof of your address. Most people send a copy of a utility bill.
I've got an electricity bill, but it's still in my flatmate's name.
Unfortunately, the bill has to be in your own name, so that won't do. Do you have anything else with the address on it?
I've got my tenancy agreement. That was signed in January.

That's fine. Please email us a copy of your tenancy agreement, and once we've checked it, the permit will be valid from the next day. You'll get a digital permit, so there's nothing to display in the car.
Brilliant. I'll scan it as soon as I get home. Thanks so much for your help.
